therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: cerebral blood flow augmentation and neuroprotection
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Regionally averaged cerebral glucose uptake changes measured by FDG PET uptake with voxel-based method at 24 weeks

results.effect_size: Left Parietal Lobe: cilostazol -1.30 vs placebo -3.27; Right Parietal Lobe: cilostazol -1.03 vs placebo -3.38; Left Inferior Frontal Gyrus: cilostazol +1.08 vs placebo -2.85 (p<0.01); Right Inferior Frontal Gyrus: cilostazol -0.72 vs placebo -2.58
results.target_engagement_evidence: FDG PET regional cerebral glucose uptake ratios measured at baseline and 24 weeks
biomarker_changes: Left Parietal Lobe FDG uptake: cilostazol baseline 81.70 → 24-week 80.40; placebo baseline 84.60 → 24-week 81.33 (p=0.14)
Right Parietal Lobe FDG uptake: cilostazol baseline 80.03 → 24-week 79.00; placebo baseline 85.29 → 24-week 81.91 (p=0.08)
Left Inferior Frontal Gyrus FDG uptake: cilostazol baseline 85.74 → 24-week 86.82; placebo baseline 85.97 → 24-week 83.12 (p<0.01)
Right Inferior Frontal Gyrus FDG uptake: cilostazol baseline 72.11 → 24-week 71.39; placebo baseline 74.02 → 24-week 71.44 (p=0.08)
subgroup_findings: Left Inferior Frontal Gyrus showed statistically significant difference between cilostazol and placebo (p<0.01), with cilostazol showing slight increase and placebo showing decline
No significant differences in other brain regions (Left Parietal p=0.14, Right Parietal p=0.08, Right Inferior Frontal p=0.08)
ADAS-cog: no significant difference between arms (p=0.93)
MMSE: no significant difference between arms (p=0.15)
ADCS-ADL: no significant difference between arms (p=0.82)
CDR-SB: no significant difference between arms (p=0.79)

dose_info.schedule: twice daily (bid); first week 50 mg bid titration
dose_info.dose_modifications: First week dose escalation: 50 mg bid, then 100 mg bid for remaining 23 weeks
